oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Canary health check alert — eu-west-edge pool. 5xx rate at 6.1% (threshold 2%). Rollout id r-20260317-34. Affected route: POST /v1/generate

alice: Seeing the same in dashboards. kvcache miss spike lines up with 5xx start at ~10:12 UTC.

miguel: Is this tied to the recent edge quantized rollout? r-20260317-34?

oncall-bot: Confirmed: rollout annotation present on requests. Canary traffic ~5% of traffic to eu-west.

alice: Error stacktrace shows downstream backend returning 502 intermittently, but traces point to gRPC pool exhaust on edge nodes.

sam: Pinging infra — @jordan can you flip the canary kill-flag for that rollout? We should abort before customer impact grows.

jordan: ACK. Cutting feature flag now: `redwood.flags.set r-20260317-34 0` -> executing.

infra-bot: Draining edge nodes: eu-west-edge-12, eu-west-edge-14. Eviction initiated.

miguel: After flag cut & drain, 5xx dropped to 0.9% within ~60s. Nice.

alice: Customer impact summary: ~120 failed requests across three customers, most were short-lived retries. No data loss, no PII leaked. Overall impact: low but visible.

sam: Rolling back the canary and marking rollout aborted: rollback id r-rollback-20260317-34. Rolling back flag and starting a full deprovision of the quantized variant.

jordan: Rollback completed, health checks stable. Will keep the canary at 0% and create follow-up task for deeper infra investigation (gRPC pool sizing + kvcache behavior).

alice: Adding runbook pointer for oncall: <https://redwood/internal/runbooks/canary-failures>. Please attach logs: `logs query "r-20260317-34"` to the incident ticket.

sam: Handoff summary for next oncall (in 30m): monitor SLO for eu-west edge, watch 5xx threshold at 1%, follow up with infra for node memory/conn metrics. Leaving paging notes in PagerDuty. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff assigned to jordan. Incident thread closed for active mitigation; reopen if errors rise above threshold.
